DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • They have Obliteration talented and Pillar of Frost is active.
  • They have Breath of Sindragosa talented and Breath of Sindragosa is currently active.
  • They aren’t using Obliteration or Breath of Sindragosa, and Pillar of Frost is active.
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • They’re in a single-target phase or adds will persist throughout the cooldown, and one of the following is true:
  • Their Gargoyle is active with ≤22 seconds remaining (prioritized for burst windows).
  • They’re using Raise Abomination talent, and the abomination is active with <18 seconds remaining.
  • They’re using Army of the Dead (without Raise Abomination), and army ghouls have ≤18 seconds remaining.
  • They’re using neither Gargoyle nor Army of the Dead talents, and Dark Transformation is active.
  • Their Gargoyle is not active, and its cooldown +10 seconds exceeds Power Infusion’s duration (prevows overlap planning).
  • Facing ≥3 enemies and either Dark Transformation is active or Death and Decay is ticking.
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • The Havoc Demonhunter has Metamorphosis active, as this is their primary damage cooldown.
  • The encounter is about to end within 20 seconds, even if cooldowns aren’t perfectly aligned.
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • The Druid has Celestial Alignment or Incarnation: Chosen of Elune active to amplify their primary damage window.
  • They’re casting Convoke the Spirits (if talented) to maximize burst damage potential.
  • Their major on-use trinkets or Kindred Empowerment procs are active for coordinated burst scaling.
  • Power Infusion is not on cooldown and aligns with their pre-planned 3-minute cooldown cycle.
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • When Bloodlust, Heroism, or Time Warp is active.
  • The Feral Druid does not have the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent selected.
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • Dragonrage is active and any of the following are true: Shattering Star isn’t on cooldown, the Shattering Star debuff is already applied to the target, or there are 2 or more enemies nearby.
  • The encounter will end in less than 35 seconds, regardless of other cooldowns.
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • Trueshot is active and has over 12 seconds remaining on its duration (to maximize damage during their strongest window).
  • The encounter will end in less than 13 seconds (to ensure the buff isn't wasted before the fight concludes).
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • Coordinated Assault is active, regardless of other abilities.
  • The hunter skipped Coordinated Assault as a talent and Spearhead is on cooldown.
  • The hunter skipped both Coordinated Assault and Spearhead as talents.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • They do not have Spymaster's Web equipped and just cast Arcane Surge (aligns with their major cooldown phase)
  • They have Spymaster's Web equipped and just cast Evocation (synergizes with the trinket's stat boost timing)
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • Power Infusion is not active and the Mage's Combustion is about to be cast (within 1-2 seconds of availability).
  • Power Infusion is not active and Combustion is already active with more than 7 seconds remaining.
  • Power Infusion is not active and the fight will end in less than 20 seconds.
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • Power Infusion is not currently active on the target.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • Xuen the White Tiger is active.
  • Either: Bloodlust is not active, or Bloodlust is active and Strike of the Windlord is on cooldown.
PALADIN_RETRIBUTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Retribution Paladin when:

  • They have Avenging Wrath active.
  • They have Crusade active (if talented).
  • Their target is affected by the Execution Sentence debuff.
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • Voidform is active, Dark Ascension is active, or their Tier Set bonus (TWW Season 2 4-piece) is triggered.
  • Power Infusion is not already active on them.
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • The Rogue's Deathmark bleed effect is active on the target, as this aligns with their highest damage window and amplifies burst potential.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • They have Shadow Dance active to amplify damage during their burst window.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • they activate Ascendance (during their major burst window), OR
  • Ascendance has more than 30 seconds remaining on its cooldown (outside of their planned burst phases)
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • Ascendance is active, Feral Spirits are summoned, or Doom Winds is active.
  • The encounter is ending within 20 seconds of a 2-minute window (to avoid holding cooldowns).
  • The Shaman’s Ascendance, Feral Spirits, or Doom Winds won’t be ready within the next 120 seconds.
  • They have not talented into Ascendance, Feral Spirits, or Doom Winds (use on cooldown).
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • They activate Darkglare and/or Summon Soulkeeper, as these cooldowns amplify their damage output and align with burst windows prioritized in APL logic.
  • Their major cooldown stacking overlaps with Soul Rot (if talented), maximizing haste synergy during high-damage phases.
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • Imps are about to despawn within the next two global cooldowns plus the cast time of Summon Demonic Tyrant.
  • They just cast Hand of Gul'dan or Ruination to maximize demon empowerment.
  • Their current imps will despawn earlier than one global cooldown plus Tyrant cast time or they have fewer than 2 Soul Shards, ensuring optimal timing for burst damage.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • Their Infernal is currently active and contributing to a major damage window.
  • They haven’t talented into Summon Infernal, making consistent damage phases your priority.
  • The encounter will end before their next Infernal cooldown AND there’s enough fight duration remaining for a full Power Infusion effect.
  • There are 15 seconds or less remaining before the fight ends beyond the expected Infernal cooldown window.
WARRIOR_ARMS:
Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:

  • the target has Colossus Smash debuff and the fight has over 135 seconds remaining
  • they are in execute phase (target ≤20% health) and have Avatar active
  • the encounter will end within 25 seconds
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • Avatar has over 15 seconds remaining and the encounter will last at least 135 more seconds.
  • The enemy is in Execute Phase (below 20% health) and Avatar is active.
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds (final burst window).
